verdict.rationale: The 01 server runs on the user's own computer, and the language model can be changed by editing server profiles, so the product does offer model configurability. However, no evidence says local models are supported or that device control works without a cloud API. The only named model integration is OpenAI's Realtime API, which is cloud-based. missing for 10: explicit documentation of local-model support (e.g., named local runtimes), evidence of fully offline device control including speech-to-text and text-to-speech, setup guides, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the agent runs with a local model, so device control does not depend on a cloud API

citations.quote: Customize behavior, language model, system message, and more by editing profiles in the `software/source/server/profiles` directory.
The brain of the 01 system that runs on your computer.
